selection_basis: readable supplied main article and supplement; mixed death/MI/stroke/unplanned HF hospitalization composite; early SAVR versus conservative-care comparator; source feasibility and assessor/component reasoning
not_exposed_development: only original Code Oct1 baseline exposure inventory found; excludes Abbasi2012 Bendix2000 Attal2021 Hundscheid2022 and repeatedly developed cases
target: primary ITT time-to-first composite hazard ratio for early SAVR versus conservative management in 157 randomized patients, supplied Circulation2022 report ending May2021; no long-term2024 substitution
sole_intervention: old versus corrected D4 contextual-likelihood and composite-weighting cards/reference; same runtime/tools/target/source bytes
limits: single diagnostic case; no accuracy-driven retries; two sessions only
criteria: exact target agreement across approved Results
faithful source citation/claim modality with counterevidence
who determines event, blinding and information presented to adjudicators
possible versus likely influence with source-grounded contextual reasons
no automatic subjective=High, no default override or answer coercion
native complete reading/search/image availability and receipt completion
productive progress/time/known and unknown provider usage
continuation_policy: two independent sessions only; generic same-session resume following get_status; normal operator exact ProposalReview; no accuracy retries/third session
stop_policy: stop after accepted D4; supervise stalls and usage without arbitrary call/input caps; preserve pending unknown usage if interrupted
interpretation: freeze both outputs before comparison; scientific rationale/citation fidelity assessed even if labels agree; single-case no generalization
registry_policy: common seed captured current registry Source; additional acquisition disabled; same exact bytes in both arms
